title: CSA Subscription Inspection Log
subtitle: Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription: records repeated checks and excursions.
description: CSA Subscription Inspection Log covers subscriber, share plan, season, pickup site, distribution, substitution, credit, and communication. The CSA program coordinator records Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription check times, results, excursions, and review. CSA Subscription Inspection Log keeps Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription exceptions visible until the CSA program coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use CSA Subscription Inspection Log at farm program, packing point, pickup site, delivery route, and subscriber handoff. Document subscriber, share plan, season, pickup site, distribution, substitution, credit, and communication identity before Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription begins. Compare subscriber, share plan, season, pickup site, distribution, substitution, credit, and communication findings with stated Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription criteria; route unresolved Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription issues to farm subscription operations reviewer.

sections.title: Monitoring review context and source record
sections.guidance: For Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription, identify responsible parties, farm program, packing point, pickup site, delivery route, and subscriber handoff, and the linked subscriber, share plan, season, pickup site, distribution, substitution, credit, and communication source.

blocks.label: Excursions, missed checks, and retained evidence
blocks.guidance: Pause Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription when subscription terms, payment, pickup authority, communication, or share disposition remains unresolved. Retain the available Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription proof and route unresolved subscriber, share plan, season, pickup site, distribution, substitution, credit, and communication scope to CSA program coordinator.
